|lore=Dark Lord of the Sith. Servant of Emperor. Encased in armor with cybernetic life support. Student of Obi-Wan Kenobi. Was the best starpilot in the galaxy. Cunning warrior.
|versions={{Card versions/Darth Vader (Premiere)}}
|strategy=By Michael Sharp, Gold 29<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20021114054040/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/premiere/dark/small/darthvader.html</ref>

What more can you say? This is [[Darth Vader]], perhaps one of the most used and most loved Star Wars CCG cards.

With power of 6 he is definately a character of choice in battles, and also has the nice touch of adding +1 to EACH battle destiny draw. So now you don't need to worry about drawing that location that you know is coming up. All this and he's immune to attrition &lt;5.

Combos:

[[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] + [[Grand Moff Tarkin{{!}}Tarkin]] - What an awesome combo! Power 10, a +1 to battle destiny draws, and the ability to cancel one of the Light Side's destiny draws!

[[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] + [[Grand Moff Tarkin{{!}}Tarkin]] + [[Vader's Cape]] (deployed on [[Grand Moff Tarkin{{!}}Tarkin]]) - POWER COMBO! Power 10, a +1 +1 to battle destiny draws, the ability to cancel one of the Light Side's destiny draws, and both are immune to attrition &lt;5!

A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border (22 January 2023). Its words are the Players Committee's errata, not Decipher's.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-D-darthvader-PC-2023-D-E1-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Darth Vader (PC Errata 2018 E card)]] (by 8 July 2018): Same words as the E card. The whole card is drawn again at a larger size, with the mark “D-E1” in place of “E”.

The whole E card image and the whole D-E1 card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
